common_prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create a standalone illustration for a high-school trigonometry exercise, landscape 3:2 composition. Scene: {scene} Style: professional textbook black ink line art, natural recognizable proportions, moderately detailed observational drawing, elegant varying line weights, sparse fine hatching only. Strictly black and white on pure white background, no colors, no gray washes, no gradients. Not a primitive geometric icon or stick figures. Clear silhouette readable at 8cm print width. Generous white margins. No text, letters, numbers, equations, angle markers, measurement arrows, labels, borders or watermark. Scene illustration only, not a solved math diagram.
